title: Self-reported archetypes and behavioral failures in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.15998v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Every large language model (LLM) has behavioral traits and moral preferences that comprise its character. Whether by design or as an emergent property of training, these systems exhibit persistent dispositions that shape how they interact, comply, resist, and err, yet the structure of LLM character remains poorly understood. We map the self-reported personality archetypes of 22 LLMs spanning closed-source frontier systems (GPT-4.0-5.2, Grok-3/4, Gemini 2.5 Pro/Flash, Claude Sonnet 4.5/4.6) and open-source models (Llama, DeepSeek, OLMo, and Qwen series). Each model self-rated across 464 bipolar semantic-differential trait pairs, and the resulting profiles were projected into a six-dimensional archetypal space derived from crowd-sourced ratings of 2,000 fictional characters using the Archetypometrics framework. Closed-source models' self-rating traits align with the empirical trait co-occurrence structure of human-rated fictional character

translated_title: 大语言模型的自我报告原型与行为失败
translated_abstract: 每个大语言模型（LLM）都具有构成其品格的行为特质和道德偏好。无论是设计使然还是训练过程的涌现属性，这些系统都表现出持久的性格倾向，塑造了它们如何互动、服从、抵制和犯错，然而LLM品格的结构仍然知之甚少。我们绘制了22个LLM的自我报告人格原型，涵盖闭源前沿系统（GPT-4.0-5.2、Grok-3/4、Gemini 2.5 Pro/Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.5/4.6）和开源模型（Llama、DeepSeek、OLMo和Qwen系列）。每个模型在464对双极语义差异特质对上进行自评，所得画像被投影到一个六维原型空间中，该空间基于对2,000个虚构角色的众包评分并通过Archetypometrics框架构建。闭源模型的自我评级特质与人类评分的虚构角色的经验特质共现结构相一致。
tldr: 本研究让22个大语言模型对464个特质对进行自我评估，并借助Archetypometrics框架将结果映射到基于2000个虚构角色的六维原型空间，首次系统刻画了LLM的自我报告人格原型结构。
en_tdlr: This study maps the self-reported personality archetypes of 22 LLMs by having them rate 464 trait pairs and projecting the profiles into a six-dimensional archetypal space derived from 2,000 fictional characters using the Archetypometrics framework.
